src='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    key_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 8)]
    cells8 = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    kr0 = min(r for r, c in key_cells)
    kr1 = max(r for r, c in key_cells)
    kc0 = min(c for r, c in key_cells)
    kc1 = max(c for r, c in key_cells)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells8)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells8)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells8)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells8)
    key = [row[kc0:kc1 + 1] for row in grid[kr0:kr1 + 1]]
    rotated = [list(row) for row in zip(*key[::-1])]
    scale = (r1 - r0 + 1) // len(rotated)
    for r, c in cells8:
        out[r][c] = rotated[(r - r0) // scale][(c - c0) // scale]
    return out
'''
